verdict.rationale: Warp documents a REST API over HR and payroll data, with write endpoints for candidate offers and worker benefit deductions. It also claims its own Warp Agent handles onboarding and that external agents can connect via MCP, which points toward agent-driven onboarding. However, the evidence never shows API endpoints for creating the employee record, setting compensation, or configuring employee tax withholding, so the end-to-end flow is unproven. Missing for 10: documented create-worker/employee endpoint, compensation setup endpoint, employee tax setup endpoint, an end-to-end onboarding example via the API or MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.
